plugins.name: upload-guard
plugins.description: Detects abnormal (unauthorized) data upload behavior in agent tool calls, warns with a top-right popup and lets the user intercept it with one click. Falls back to the host's native PreToolUse confirmation when no GUI is available.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 检测 Agent 工具调用中的异常（未授权）数据外发行为，右上角弹窗提示，可一键截获；无界面时回退 ZCode 原生确认。
